title: Action Cart Management
caption: View, manage, and schedule saved action carts.
subCaption: Scheduled action carts are flagged with a notification on run time.

empty.title: No saved action carts found
empty.info: Populate and use action cart in header to save cart for further management.

load.label: Current action list not empty
load.caption: Select option to add to existing cart or replace.

details.label: Toggle details
details.caption: Expand row to show all details for this action cart.

load.label: Load
load.caption: Put actions from this cart into active cart.

edit.label: Schedule / Edit
edit.caption: Edit details and optionally notify me when this cart is due for execution.

pause.label: Skip schedule
pause.caption: Prevent this cart from sending notifications for upcoming runs.
